The pipe subtracts call implied volatility from put implied volatility at the listed strikes nearest 10 percent from spot, and a wider positive gap means hedges cost more than upside. The October 26 contract marks a 73k put at 60.53 percent against an 89k call at 51.85 percent, while the October 25 contract marks a 74k put at 73.62 percent against an 89k call at 54.68 percent.
